podcast.title: Collaborator with Sean Lennon
podcast.body: Albert Hammond Jr., a member of The Strokes, has collaborated on records with Sean Lennon. "collaborated on records with people like Albert Hammond Jr. of the Strokes."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Son of Albert Hammond
podcast.body: Albert Hammond Jr. is the son of Albert Hammond, who co-wrote "The Air That I Breathe" for The Hollies and received songwriting credits on Radiohead's "Creep." "Albert Hammond is the father of Albert Hammond Jr. of the Strokes."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
